dhp290:4:
sukhaṃ → mātrāsukha parityāgādyaඃ paśyecipulaṃ sukham 
tyajenmātrāsukhaṃ dhīraඃ saṃpaśyan cipulaṃ sukham. (udānavarga-sukhavarga 5-30)
dhp291:4:
parimuccati → para duhuvadanena yo atmano suhamichati 
vera saśaga sasaṭho so duha na parimucatī (prā. dha. C vo . 42)
dhp293:6:
āsavā → yeṣāntu susamārabdhā nityaṃ kāyagatā smṛtiඃ 
akṛtyaṃ te na kurvanti kṛtye sātatyakāriṇaඃ 
smṛtānāṃ samprajānānāmasataṃ gacchanti āśravāඃ (udānavarga 4. 19. 20)
dhp294:4:
brāhmaṇo → supraudhu praujati im gotamaśavaka 
yeṣa divaya rati ca nica budhakata smati (prā. dha. A 4 5)
dhp297:4: sati → supraudhu....... nica dhamakata smati (prā. dha. A 4 5)
dhp298:4:
sati → supraudhū praujhati sada gotamaśavaka 
yeṣa diva ya rati ca nica saghakata smati (prā. dha. A 4 6)
dhp299:4: sati → supradhū...... nica kayakata smati (prā. dha. A 4 7)
dhp300:4: mano → supraudhū........ ahiṃsai rato mano (prā. dha. A 4 8)
dhp301:4: mano → supraudhū..... bhavanai rato mano (prā. dha. A 4 8)
dhp303:4:
pūjito → sadhū śīlena sabano yaśa bhoga samapitū 
yena yeneva cayati tena teneva puyita. (prā. dha. C. 25)
